question: How many total medals did India win at the World Boxing Cup Brazil 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**6**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Boxing Cup Brazil 2025: Hitesh Gulia punches gold as India finish with six medals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India** won **6 medals** at **World Boxing Cup Brazil 2025**.

 
 
• 
 
The event was held in **Foz Do Iguacu, Brazil.**

 
 
• 
 
**Hitesh Gulia** won **gold** in **men’s 70kg** — **first Indian** to win gold at the World Boxing Cup.

 
 
• 
 
Other medalists:

 
 
• 
 
**Abhinash Jamwal** – **silver**, **men’s 65kg**

 
 
• 
 
**Jadumani Singh Mandengbam** – **bronze**, **men’s 50kg**

 
 
• 
 
**Manish Rathore** – **bronze**, **men’s 55kg**

 
 
• 
 
**Sachin** – **bronze**, **men’s 60kg**

 
 
• 
 
**Vishal** – **bronze**, **men’s 90kg**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Brazil Cup is **1 of 3** World Boxing Cups in **2025**.

 
 
• 
 
Next hosts: **Kazakhstan** (June-July) and **India** (November)
